## Coaching Points

- Drive knees upward for each step
- Drive arms aggressively in opposition to the legs
- A slight forward lean is used throughout the drill
- Take only one step around each bag

## 2b. Shuffle

## Procedure

1. Position bags 5 yards apart
2. Beginning at either the right or left bag, shuffle diagonally to the far side of the first bag (-27)
3. Use the outside foot to plant and explode diagonally toward the far side of the next bag (continue this weaving pattern through the three bags)
4. Finish the drill by sprinting 5 yards

## Coaching Points

- Stay low throughout the drill
- Avoid using a cross-over step
- Take only one step around each bag
